description:
# Minecraft Font + Unicode Support

Brings the Minecraft font into League of Legends with extended Unicode support.

This mod uses `MinecraftDefaultUniformBMP-Regular.ttf`, generated from the Minecraft `26.3-pre-2` font batch, and updates older Minecraft font mods with broader character coverage for symbols, accented letters, Cyrillic, Greek, CJK, Arabic, and more.

For matching Minecraft Gold Text icons, use:

[**Minecraft Gold Text Extended**](https://www.divineskins.gg/tor.lol/minecraft-gold-text-extended)

Got an idea for another Mod or UI specific Whish? Send recommendations! I’m always looking for fun new ones to make.
